notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a new update for the CLUAIDO demo, packed with new languages, exciting features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience!

[h2]New Language Support[/h2]
CLUAIDO is now fully available in 🇯🇵 Japanese,  🇨🇳 Chinese, 🇷🇺 Russian, and 🇰🇷 Korean! We’re thrilled to bring the mystery of Mr. Hamilton’s murder to players around the world, making the game more accessible to our diverse global community.

[h2]Enhanced Plot and Character Depth[/h2]
We’ve added new clues that deepen the storyline and give you more insight into the characters’ backstories. These new elements will enrich your investigative experience, adding layers of intrigue and making every suspect more complex and interesting.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We’ve squashed some bugs to ensure smoother gameplay. Thank you for your feedback—your reports have helped us improve the game.

[h2]Artwork Enhancements[/h2]
We’ve also made some visual upgrades to the artwork, refining the aesthetic to better capture the atmosphere of the game.

Dive back into the world of CLUAIDO and explore these new updates. We can’t wait to hear what you think!
